title: Bug: CodeQL looses location information for some findings
body:
### Description

Partial sarif report:

```
{
              "id": 2,
              "physicalLocation": {
                "artifactLocation": {
                  "uri": "file:/"
                }
              },
              "message": {
                "text": "Result"
              }
            }
```

The uri should not be an empty path.

### Error Occurrence  Rate

None

### How to reproduce

bazel run //quality/static_analysis:codeql_lint -- --target=//score/mw/com/impl/...

### Supporting Information

_No response_

### Classification

minor

### Affected Version

v0.3.0

### Category

- [ ] Safety Related
- [ ] Security Related
